''Houhanshu'', vol.06</ref> – 15 February 145<ref>Emperor Chong's biography in ''Book of the Later Han'' recorded that he died aged 3 (by East Asian reckoning) on the ''wuxu'' day of the 1st month of the 1st year of the ''Yongxi'' era of his reign. 16 December 125<ref>''dingsi'' day of the 11th month of the 3rd year of the ''Yan'guang'' era, per Emperor Shun's biography in ''Book of the Later Han''</ref> – 20 September 144

28 September 189 – 11 December 220{{sfnp|de Crespigny|2007|p=xxxiii}}{{efn|According to Emperor Xian's biography in ''Book of the Later Han'', Liu Xie abdicated the throne on the ''yimao'' day of the 10th month of the 1st year of the ''Yankang'' era of his reign. This corresponds to 25 Nov 220 in the Julian calendar.<ref>({{lang|zh|三月，改元延康。冬十月乙卯，皇帝逊位，魏王丕称天子。}}) ''Houhanshu'', vol.09.</ref> The ''Zizhi Tongjian'' recorded that while Liu Xie did abdicate on the ''yimao'' day of the 10th month, Cao Pi only ascended the throne on the ''xinwei'' day of the same month (16 days later), which corresponds to 11 Dec 220 on the Julian calendar.<ref>({{lang|zh|冬，十月，乙卯，汉帝告祠高庙，使行御史大夫张音持节奉玺绶诏册，禅位于魏。王三上书辞让，乃为坛于繁阳，辛未，升坛受玺绶，即皇帝位，}}...) ''Zizhi Tongjian'', vol.69</ref>}}

13 December 220<ref>''guiyou'' day of the 11th month of the 1st year of the ''Huangchu'' era, per Cao Pi's biography in ''Sanguozhi''. [[Cao Song]] was also posthumously made emperor on the same day.</ref> – 21 April 234

6 March 145<ref>Emperor Zhi's biography in ''Book of the Later Han'' recorded that he ascended the throne on the ''dingsi'' day  of the 1st month of the 1st year of the ''Yongxi'' era of Emperor Chong's reign. This corresponds to 6 Mar 145 on the Julian calendar. ([永憙元年春正月]丁巳，封为建平侯，其日即皇帝位，...) ''Houhanshu'', vol.06</ref>  – 26 July 146<ref>Emperor Zhi's biography in ''Book of the Later Han'' recorded that he died aged 9 (by East Asian reckoning) on the ''jiashen'' day of the leap month of the 1st year of the ''Benchu'' era of his reign. This corresponds to 26 Jul 146 on the Julian calendar. ([本初元年]闰月甲申，大将军梁冀潜行鸩弑，帝崩于玉堂前殿，年九岁。) ''Houhanshu'', vol.06</ref>
